plain: A researcher named Diana Pasulka says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2024 that Jack Parsons, whom she calls the father of the American space program, believed he was in contact with something beyond us. She notes that he worked with the occultist Aleister Crowley, and tells it to show how close early space science sat to beliefs about contact with other beings.
